fact: On 23 April 2026 Telecom Namibia and Angola Telecom, the two national operators, signed an MoU and Commercial Terms Agreement giving Angola Telecom access to international capacity via Telecom Namibia's Equiano landing at Swakopmund and laying groundwork for Angola Telecom's SARSSy subsea cable.
title: Telecom Namibia and Angola Telecom Sign Strategic MOU and Commercial Terms Agreement to Strengthen Regional Connectivity
